laws: execution-context is not an authorization token
client cannot choose execution_context_id or trace_id
action-time authority is revalidated by Trust Gateway through AIE
authority_epoch from dispatch.acceptance/1.0 is not reinterpreted in 2.0
final verification subject is not supplied at initial dispatch acceptance
verification subject is bound only after the immutable candidate exists
same-subject replay is idempotent and different-subject rebinding fails closed
